reviews.title: Clapper is pushing away the creators who made this app worth using
reviews.text:
I’ve been a creator and active community member on Clapper for a long time, and I’m extremely disappointed with the direction the app is heading.

Clapper has always stood out because it was one of the few platforms that actually welcomed creators who didn’t fit the traditional social media mold, including NSFW creators. Unfortunately, it now feels like that is changing.

Clapper is removing multiple features that creators and supporters actually use, including Mystery Boxes/“Treasure Chests,” DM Tipping, and Multi-Live Paid Rooms. These aren’t meaningless features. They are ways that supporters spend coins and directly support creators.

I contacted Clapper Support about the removal of Mystery Boxes and explained that I personally run a Mystery Box group and moderate several others. I also explained that I make around $40 a day from Mystery Boxes alone, meaning Clapper is taking a percentage of that revenue too. Their response was essentially that the features are being discontinued and that they don’t know if they’ll ever return.

What makes this especially frustrating is the confusion surrounding “Treasure Chests.” There used to be an actual Treasure Chest feature on Clapper that was already removed, so creators are now left wondering whether Clapper is referring to that feature or the Mystery Boxes currently being used in groups. That should not be this difficult to clarify.

reviews.title: Star Review: Clapper Is a Lawless Harassment Hub That Apple Needs to Shut Down Now
reviews.text:
Clapper claims to be a creative social platform, but in reality it’s a breeding ground for unchecked bullying, stalking, and defamation that destroys lives while the company does next to nothing about it.
The moderation is an absolute joke. Reports disappear into the void, met with nothing but robotic, generic replies that say they “take safety seriously” while toxic users run wild. Burner accounts are everywhere because Clapper doesn’t bother checking IPs or device IDs—it’s practically an open invitation for abusers. Live streams and comment sections have become unbearable war zones, driving people away and leaving creators isolated and emotionally drained.
This isn’t occasional oversight. It’s a clear pattern: profit over people. Features designed for engagement are weaponized to amplify harm with zero meaningful safeguards. Young creators trying to build something positive get chewed up and spat out while the worst offenders face no real consequences.
Apple has pulled apps for far less serious violations. Clapper’s blatant disregard for user safety, harassment policies, and basic platform responsibility makes it a liability. If the App Store guidelines mean anything, Apple should launch a full investigation and remove this app before more people get hurt.
Clapper needs to either fix its broken system immediately or be taken off the store. Right now it’s failing creators, failing its community, and failing basic decency. One star is generous. Do not download.

reviews.title: Creators Aren’t Protected Here
reviews.text: I’m extremely disappointed with how inconsistent this platform is when it comes to enforcement. My account was disabled due to what I believe were mass false reports, yet I was never given clear evidence or a proper explanation of what I supposedly did wrong. I reached out via email and received no meaningful response. For months, I’ve been the target of ongoing harassment and bullying from another creator. This individual has repeatedly mocked and targeted me publicly during live streams, and despite reporting it, no action has been taken. Meanwhile, I received warnings quickly and ultimately lost access to my account. It feels like the platform selectively enforces its policies. Multiple creators have gone live to insult me and damage my reputation, and those behaviors appear to go unchecked. Targeted harassment and defamation should be taken seriously, and creators deserve transparency and fair treatment. I hope the platform improves its review process and takes reports of bullying more seriously. Users should be aware of how inconsistent moderation can be.

reviews.title: Clapper Fails Genuine Creators
reviews.text: I’ve been a content creator on Clapper for almost a year, and my experience has become extremely disappointing. I have repeatedly reached out for help about ongoing harassment, bullying, stalking, and targeted false reports, yet Clapper has consistently failed to respond or take meaningful action. I’ve submitted clear evidence (screenshots, videos, timelines) none of which received any follow-up. Meanwhile, the users who targeted me continue to thrive on the platform with full visibility, strong algorithm support, and no consequences. Despite being the one reporting serious misconduct, my account is the one that has been restricted, shadowed, and even disabled based on false reports. Clapper removed my account over a situation that could have easily been resolved with a real investigation, but instead of reviewing the evidence, they penalized me, the person being targeted. It’s extremely discouraging and unacceptable that a platform claiming to support its creators allows false reporting and targeted harassment to go unchecked. Genuine creators should not have to fight this hard to be heard, especially when providing proof that cannot be fabricated. I am leaving this review because Clapper has made it clear that creators facing harassment should not expect proper support or protection.
